name: print-social-instagram-feed-flatlay-mockup-neutral-florals
title: Neutral Instagram feed mockup with floral flat-lay
whatItIs: A phone-screen Instagram profile mockup shown beside repeated flat-lay preview panels, all styled in a beige/cream palette with a floral macro photo, a notebook and earbuds.
whatItMeans: The single warm background color unifies every panel into one cohesive grid, so the eye reads it as a considered aesthetic rather than a jumble of separate images.
techniques: restrict all imagery to one warm neutral palette so the grid reads as curated
pair a device mockup with cropped detail shots to sell the feel of the whole feed at once
repeat the same composition at shrinking scale to show consistency across a series
bestFor: personal brand or lifestyle Instagram grids
mockup packs for selling design templates
portfolio presentation of a social content system

vocabulary.definition: a photography style shooting objects from directly overhead on a flat surface
